smartCharging.title: Charging readiness

solar.title: Solar charging opportunities
solar.privacy: Off by default. Allow read-only Tesla Energy access for one site, then choose a home charger for this vehicle. No push, vehicle wake, charging change, or change to your backup reserve.
solar.linkFailed: Tesla Energy was not connected. Check the site ID and Tesla permissions, then try again.
solar.unavailable: Setup requires Tesla Fleet API credentials, an HTTPS callback registered with Tesla, encryption, and shared live signals.
solar.siteHelp: Use the energy_site_id of your Solar and Powerwall installation from the Tesla Fleet API Products endpoint. The site ID is sent to Tesla to verify access and read its status.
solar.enable: Enable solar checks for this vehicle
solar.opportunity: There may be surplus solar available to charge
solar.rationale: Repeated export readings show the home battery remains above its configured reserve.
solar.basis: Timestamped Tesla Energy readings and fresh shared vehicle signals
solar.evidence: At least {{export}} was exported across {{samples}} readings since {{start}}. Your home battery was at {{backup}}% with a {{reserve}}% reserve. The plugged-in vehicle was at {{battery}}%, below its {{target}}% limit.
solar.timing: Evidence as of {{observed}}; advice expires at {{expires}}. Export can change. If you have not already started, review charging on the car while parked.
solar.noDecision: No current opportunity. Checks require a locally observed parked, plugged-in vehicle below its limit, sustained export, and backup above the reserve.
solar.off: Solar checks are off for this vehicle.
solar.disable: Turn off solar checks for this vehicle
solar.disconnect: Disconnect Tesla Energy and remove all solar plans

publicFee.title: Public charging fee reminders
publicFee.privacy: Off by default. Review fixed, current terms for one public charging place. TeslaSync does not check station occupancy, contact the operator, or operate the car. An optional push carries only a short-lived token.
publicFee.confirmPlace: I verified this location is a public charging site
publicFee.confirmTerms: I reviewed fixed terms that apply after completion while connected, with no occupancy or other conditions
publicFee.allowPush: Send fee reminders to this verified browser
publicFee.verifyDevice: Confirm this browser in Personal browser notifications before enabling push. You can still save the review without push.
publicFee.invalid: Enter a public HTTPS source, exact fee and currency, 2–60 minutes of grace, and 1–30 days of validity. Both reviews are required.
publicFee.needsReview: Review the terms again. The previous review expired or the charging place changed.
publicFee.off: No active public-site fee review is saved for this vehicle.
publicFee.action: Charging finished and the car was still connected
publicFee.timing: The reviewed fee is {{rate}} per minute after the grace period. It could start as early as {{earliest}}. Check the station and move the car if it is safe.
publicFee.observed: Connection evidence observed at {{when}}. This is not a statement that a fee was charged.
publicFee.noDecision: There is no current fee reminder for this session. It may have expired or the evidence may have changed.
publicFee.pushTitle: A charging fee may start soon
publicFee.pushBody: Charging has finished. Open TeslaSync for the reviewed fee terms and timing.

sitePerformance.title: Charging at a saved place
sitePerformance.privacy: Off by default. Allow TeslaSync to compare this vehicle’s completed sessions at one reviewed charging place. Nothing is sent outside TeslaSync and this does not enable push.
sitePerformance.empty: No repeated slowdown is supported by comparable sessions for this place.
sitePerformance.actionTitle: Charging has been slower at this place
sitePerformance.summary: {{recentCount}} recent sessions averaged {{recent}} at {{place}}; the median across {{baselineCount}} comparable sessions was {{baseline}}.
sitePerformance.rationale: Two recent sessions delivered materially less energy per elapsed hour than comparable sessions for the same vehicle and location.
sitePerformance.basis: Timestamped charging meter readings and similar charge levels and connector type
sitePerformance.limitation: Elapsed rates can include pauses. Review the current limit, schedule and site conditions; this is not a charger diagnosis.

smartCharging.vehicleUnavailable: That vehicle is unavailable. Select a vehicle explicitly; no other vehicle was selected.
smartCharging.chooseVehicle: Choose the vehicle whose charging plans you want to manage.
smartCharging.identityMissingDescription: Your authentication provider did not supply a verified identity.
smartCharging.changeFailed: The change was not saved. Refresh and try again.
smartCharging.description: Plans are off until you enable them. The notification worker checks fresh shared signals for unplugged or slow charging without waking the car. Advice appears in Action Center; personal browser notifications require separate device consent.
smartCharging.requirements: Checks require a running notification worker, shared live signals, and a reviewed place marked as a charging location. Stale or missing evidence produces no advice.
smartCharging.noPlaces: Add or review a charging place in Locations before creating a plan.
smartCharging.noPlans: No trip plan is saved. Add one when you want readiness checks.
smartCharging.destinationChargePlan: Planned destination charge: {{charge}}% added; not confirmed.
smartCharging.placeUnavailable: The selected charging place is unavailable or needs review.
smartCharging.latestStartPaused: Latest-start refresh is paused while offline. Reconnect to check live charging power.
smartCharging.latestStartEmpty: Estimates appear for enabled, unsnoozed plans when fresh battery and charging signals are available.
smartCharging.latestStartUnavailable: A current estimate is unavailable. Fresh battery and pack-capacity data are required.
smartCharging.latestStartExpired: This estimate expired because its live evidence is no longer fresh. Refresh to check again.
smartCharging.latestStartPlanChanged: This plan changed. Refresh its estimate before relying on it.
smartCharging.latestStartSufficient: Your current battery meets the trip-use and reserve estimate you entered; no charge is estimated as necessary.
smartCharging.latestStartSufficientWithDestination: No extra charge is estimated before departure if the planned destination charging happens. Check that the plan is still feasible.
smartCharging.latestStartUnachievable: The upper trip-use estimate plus your reserve exceeds 100% battery, so this trip target cannot be reached by charging alone.
smartCharging.latestStartLegsUnachievable: The higher leg estimates and reserve cannot be met by charging only at the selected place. Review a stop or planned destination charging.
smartCharging.latestStartNotCharging: No positive charging power is currently measured. A connected plug alone is not enough to estimate a safe start.
smartCharging.latestStartUnknownLocation: A fresh parked location is required to confirm charging power at the selected place.
smartCharging.latestStartOutsideSite: The vehicle is not confirmed at the selected charging place, so power measured elsewhere cannot be used.
smartCharging.latestStartOverdue: At the measured {{power}}, the estimated start for your higher trip-use value has passed. Check the vehicle; no schedule was changed.
smartCharging.latestStartEstimate: Using the nominal pack-energy estimate and measured {{power}} at the selected place, start by {{earliest}} for your higher trip-use value or {{latest}} for your lower value (observed {{observed}}). Estimates include a 25% time buffer; actual charging power can change.
smartCharging.rateComparisonEstimate: For the higher trip-use estimate ({{energy}}), charging now is about {{now}}; starting at {{start}} is about {{later}}, saving {{saving}} ({{currency}}).
smartCharging.rateComparisonLimits: Based on the place’s dated prices and the current measured power, with a 25% time buffer. Power can change; taxes, fixed fees and charging losses are excluded. Savings must be at least 10% and one currency unit. No schedule is changed.
smartCharging.deleteDescription: This removes the plan and its pending decision. It does not delete driving or charging records.
smartCharging.formPrivacy: Your estimate and chosen charging place stay on this server. Enabling this plan does not start charging or send a vehicle command.
smartCharging.timeZoneHint: Times use {{zone}}. A repeated daylight-saving time uses its first occurrence; skipped times must be changed.
smartCharging.scheduledStartHint: Enter the date and time you expect charging to start, between “Check from” and one day after departure. This does not set a vehicle schedule.
smartCharging.schedulePowerCeilingHint: Enter a known upper limit for this charging place. Leave blank if you do not know it. This does not change charging power.
smartCharging.legEstimateHint: Enter a low and high battery-use estimate for each leg. These are your estimates, not measured route predictions.
smartCharging.destinationChargeHint: Optional. This is a plan, not a confirmed or guaranteed charge. Leave blank to assume no destination charging.
smartCharging.destinationUnreachable: With {{start}}% at departure, even the lower outbound estimate exceeds the available charge. Review a stop before the destination.
smartCharging.destinationEstimate: With {{start}}% at departure, estimated charge at the destination is {{low}}-{{high}}% against a {{reserve}}% reserve.
smartCharging.destinationUncertain: The higher outbound estimate may leave the destination unreachable.
smartCharging.returnUnreachable: The return cannot be completed without an additional charge under these estimates.
smartCharging.returnEstimate: If the destination is reached, the estimated return charge is {{low}}-{{high}}%.
smartCharging.returnUncertain: The higher return-use estimate may require another charge.
smartCharging.noDestinationChargeAssumption: The return estimate assumes no destination charging.
smartCharging.destinationChargeAssumption: The return estimate assumes the planned {{charge}}% destination charge; it is not confirmed or guaranteed.
smartCharging.tripProjectionLimitation: These are estimates, not measurements. A 0% bound may mean a leg cannot be completed.
smartCharging.reviewStop: Review a charging stop in Trip Planner
smartCharging.enablePlan: Enable readiness checks for this plan
smartCharging.compareSiteRates: Compare costs using verified place prices
smartCharging.compareSiteRatesConsent: Enable only after checking that this place’s dated price windows and currency apply to your future charging. Historical prices are not recurring tariffs.
smartCharging.invalidPlan: Choose an active charging place, valid percentages and times at least 30 minutes apart. Departure must be within the next year. Skipped daylight-saving times are not valid.
smartCharging.decisionUnavailable: This decision is no longer actionable. Refresh the action center.
smartCharging.actionTitle: Plug in before your planned trip
smartCharging.actionSummary: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}; the trip estimate suggests {{low}}-{{high}}% on return versus a {{reserve}}% reserve. Departure: {{departure}}.
smartCharging.actionRationale: Fresh parked and disconnected signals place the vehicle inside the selected charging location.
smartCharging.actionBasisSignals: Fresh battery, gear, plug state and location observations
smartCharging.actionBasisEstimate: Trip consumption and reserve were entered by you
smartCharging.actionLimitationEstimate: Return charge is an estimate based on the range you entered, not a measurement.
smartCharging.actionLimitationWrites: This recommendation cannot start charging or operate the vehicle.
smartCharging.tripReviewTitle: Review a charging stop before your trip
smartCharging.tripReviewSummary: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}. Review a charging stop or record planned destination charging. Departure: {{departure}}.
smartCharging.tripReviewRationale: Even the lower entered trip-use estimates cannot meet the reserve by charging only at the selected place.
smartCharging.slowActionTitle: Charging may not be ready before your trip
smartCharging.scheduleActionTitle: Review charging scheduled for departure or later
smartCharging.scheduleActionSummary: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}. If charging starts at the time you entered ({{start}}), it will not add charge before departure ({{departure}}).
smartCharging.scheduleActionRationale: The vehicle is plugged in and reports a pending schedule matching the clock time you entered.
smartCharging.scheduleActionBasis: Fresh charging-port latch and pending schedule observations
smartCharging.scheduleActionLimitation: The vehicle reports a clock time, not the date of the next start. No schedule was changed.
smartCharging.schedulePowerActionTitle: Scheduled charging may finish too late for your trip
smartCharging.schedulePowerActionSummary: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}. If charging starts at {{start}}, even the {{power}} limit you entered may not leave enough charge for your {{departure}} departure.
smartCharging.schedulePowerActionBasis: Fresh nominal pack energy and the site power limit you entered
smartCharging.schedulePowerActionLimitation: The estimate assumes uninterrupted charging at the entered limit without losses. The limit is not measured power.
smartCharging.conflictWindowsHint: Record an appointment or install window you confirmed. Leave both times blank to remove a window. Update it here if plans change; TeslaSync does not update or verify the source schedule.
smartCharging.overlapPush: Send a private push for a departure conflict
smartCharging.overlapPushHint: Requires verified personal charging push. If both windows overlap departure, the card shows the service appointment first.
smartCharging.invalidConflictWindow: Enter both times in order and within seven days of departure, or leave both blank. Skipped daylight-saving times are not valid.
smartCharging.serviceOverlapTitle: Service appointment overlaps your planned departure
smartCharging.installOverlapTitle: Scheduled software install overlaps your planned departure
smartCharging.serviceOverlapRationale: The appointment window you entered includes the saved departure.
smartCharging.installOverlapRationale: The software install window you entered includes the saved departure.
smartCharging.overlapSummary: Review the window from {{start}} to {{end}} before your planned departure at {{departure}}.
smartCharging.overlapBasisPlan: Window and departure entered by you
smartCharging.overlapLimitation: The window is entered by you, not verified against a service or vehicle schedule. No schedule was changed.
smartCharging.slowActionSummary: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}. At the measured {{power}}, the estimated return is {{low}}-{{high}}% versus a {{reserve}}% reserve. Departure: {{departure}}.
smartCharging.slowActionRationale: Fresh samples over at least five minutes indicate the current charging rate may not meet the trip reserve.
smartCharging.slowActionBasis: Fresh parked, charging, battery, pack-energy and charging-power observations
smartCharging.slowActionLimitationEstimate: The estimate assumes constant power and nominal pack energy; actual power, taper and efficiency can change.
smartCharging.slowActionLimitationWrites: This recommendation does not change a schedule, charging limit or vehicle setting.
smartCharging.slowCurrentEvidence: The vehicle reports an AC current request of {{requested}} A and maximum request of {{maximum}} A.
smartCharging.slowCurrentBasis: Fresh AC current request and maximum request observations
smartCharging.slowCurrentSafety: Review the current setting and site electrical limits; the reported maximum does not establish that increasing current is safe or will help.
smartCharging.slowTripActionContext: Battery {{battery}}% at {{place}}; measured charging power is {{power}}. Departure: {{departure}}.
smartCharging.privateHistory: Charging-plan actions are managed in Settings, not the general action history.

delivery.title: Personal browser notifications
delivery.privacy: Your browser’s push service receives an encrypted, short-lived token, not trip details. TeslaSync checks the same account and current consent before showing a generic notification.
delivery.shared: Without sign-in, anyone with access to TeslaSync can manage these delivery devices.
delivery.serverUnavailable: Personal delivery needs VAPID credentials and the same encryption key on the API and notification worker. Existing alert channels are separate.
delivery.browserUnavailable: Personal browser delivery needs a supported browser and a secure, same-origin connection.
delivery.owned: This browser is linked to another account. Sign in as its owner to disconnect it first.
delivery.connectFailed: Could not confirm this browser. Check notification permission and server configuration, then retry.
delivery.changeFailed: The delivery preference was not saved. Refresh and retry.
delivery.disconnectFailed: The device could not be fully disconnected. Refresh and retry; remove any remaining browser subscription if needed.
delivery.clearFailed: The browser subscription could not be removed. Retry from this browser.
delivery.empty: No personal devices are connected. Charging push is off by default.
delivery.disconnectDescription: Pending personal deliveries are invalidated. Plans and existing alert channels are unchanged.
delivery.pending: Waiting for this browser to confirm its subscription.
delivery.verifyBody: This browser is ready for personal notifications.
delivery.pushBody: Open TeslaSync to review a charging decision.
